<?php

namespace Modules\Sales\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\MeasuredController;
use App\Traits\ChecksLogin;
use App\Traits\ChecksPermissions;

class OrderController extends MeasuredController
{
    use ChecksLogin, ChecksPermissions;

    private const ROUTE_PREFIX = 'sales.orders';
    private const MIDDLEWARE   = ['auth', 'verified'];

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware(self::MIDDLEWARE);
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $this->authorizePermission('view_orders');
        $orders = Order::paginate(25);
        return view('sales::orders.index', compact('orders'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $this->authorizePermission('create_orders');
        // Transpiled from Django's OrderCreateView.post()
        $validated = $request->validate([...]);
        $order = Order::create($validated);
        return redirect(getRedirectUrl(self::ROUTE_PREFIX . '.show', ['id' => $order->id]));
    }
}

step.description: Create Laravel middleware with extensive logging.
step.code:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class LogActivity
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        Log::info('Request entry', [
            'method' => $request->method(),
            'path'   => $request->path(),
            'user'   => $request->user()?->id,
            'ip'     => $request->ip(),
        ]);

        $response = $next($request);

        Log::info('Request completed', [
            'method' => $request->method(),
            'path'   => $request->path(),
            'status' => $response->getStatusCode(),
        ]);

        return $response;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Traits\UsesUuids;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Order extends Model
{
    use UsesUuids, SoftDeletes;

    protected $fillable = [
        'order_number',   // ! CHANGED from 'order_no' in Django
        'total_amount',
        'status',
        'customer_id',    // ! CHANGED from 'client_id' in Django
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'total_amount' => 'decimal:2',
        'metadata'     => 'array',
    ];

    // Never change querying logic from Django.
    // TODO: Consider adding scope for active orders (was filtered in Django manager)

    public function customer()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Customer::class);
    }

    public function items()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderItem::class);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Exports;

use App\Models\Order;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromQuery;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadings;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithStyles;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\Worksheet;

class OrdersExport implements FromQuery, WithHeadings, WithStyles
{
    public function query()
    {
        return Order::query()->with('customer');
    }

    public function headings(): array
    {
        return ['ID', 'Order Number', 'Customer', 'Total', 'Status', 'Created'];
    }

    public function styles(Worksheet $sheet): array
    {
        return [
            1 => [
                'font' => ['bold' => true, 'size' => 12],
                'borders' => [
                    'bottom' => ['borderStyle' => \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Border::BORDER_THIN],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

step.description: Approach B: Python-endpoint for complex transformations.
All helper functions used across transpiled layers.
step.code:
<?php

namespace App\Helpers;

use Illuminate\Http\Response;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use App\Models\User;

class TranspilationHelpers
{
    /**
     * Get redirect URL for a named route. Replaces Django reverse().
     */
    public static function getRedirectUrl(string $routeName, array $params = []): string
    {
        if (!Route::has($routeName)) {
            return url('/');
        }
        return route($routeName, $params);
    }

    /**
     * Standardized 403 response. Replaces Django PermissionDenied.
     */
    public static function defaultPermissionDenial(): Response
    {
        return response('Permission denied.', 403);
    }

    /**
     * Standardized 500 error for unexpected states.
     */
    public static function defaultUndefinedException(string $message = ''): Response
    {
        $msg = $message ?: 'An unexpected error occurred.';
        return response($msg, 500);
    }

    /**
     * Validate email format. Replaces Django EmailValidator.
     */
    public static function emailValidation(string $email): bool
    {
        return (bool) filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
    }

    /**
     * Validate UUID format and user existence.
     */
    public static function userIdValidation(string $id): bool
    {
        if (!Str::isUuid($id)) {
            return false;
        }
        return User::where('id', $id)->exists();
    }

    /**
     * Returns middleware closure for permission checking.
     * Replaces Django @permission_required.
     */
    public static function permissionRequiredCustom(string $permission): \Closure
    {
        return function ($request, $next) use ($permission) {
            if (!$request->user()?->can($permission)) {
                abort(403, 'Permission denied.');
            }
            return $next($request);
        };
    }
}
